translations.literal: The next day they came in close combat to seize Xiaofeng Ridge and divided forces to attack Zhushan Gate; Xipeng and Guohong both died in battle and the county seat fell.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they came in close combat to seize Xiaofeng Ridge and divided forces to attack Zhushan Gate. Xipeng and Guohong both died in battle and the county seat fell.

sentences.zh: 敵萃攻土城，雲飛知不可為，出敕印付營弁，率親兵二百，持刀步入敵中，轉鬥二里許，格殺無算。

translations.literal: The enemy converged to attack the earthen wall; Yunfei knew it could not be held, sent out his seal and orders to camp officers, led two hundred personal troops with swords in hand into the enemy ranks, and fought for nearly two li, killing untold numbers.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy converged to attack the earthen wall. Yunfei knew it could not be held, sent out his seal and orders to camp officers, and led two hundred personal troops with swords in hand into the enemy ranks, fighting for nearly two li and killing untold numbers.

sentences.zh: 至竹山麓，頭面右手被斫，猶血戰，身受四十餘創，砲洞胸背，植立崖石而死。

translations.literal: At the foot of Zhushan his head, face, and right hand were cut down, yet he still fought bleeding; he received more than forty wounds, cannon pierced his chest and back, and he died standing planted against the cliff rock.
translations.idiomatic: At the foot of Zhushan his head, face, and right hand were cut down, yet he still fought bleeding. He received more than forty wounds, cannon pierced his chest and back, and he died standing planted against the cliff rock.

sentences.zh: 定海義勇徐保夜負其屍，浮舟渡海。

translations.literal: Dinghai volunteer Xu Bao carried his body away by night and crossed the sea in a small boat.
translations.idiomatic: Dinghai volunteer Xu Bao carried his body away by night and crossed the sea in a small boat.

sentences.zh: 是役連戰六晝夜，斃敵千餘，卒以眾寡不敵，三鎮同殉。

translations.literal: In this battle they fought six days and nights in succession, killed more than a thousand enemy, but in the end could not match numbers; the three commanders all died as martyrs.
translations.idiomatic: In this battle they fought six days and nights in succession and killed more than a thousand enemy, but in the end could not match numbers and the three commanders all died as martyrs.

sentences.zh: 事聞，宣宗揮淚下詔，賜金治喪，卹典依提督例，予騎都尉兼一云騎尉世職，諡壯節。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported the Xuanzong Emperor wiped away tears and issued an edict, granted gold for the funeral, posthumous favors according to the provincial admiral precedent, the combined hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry with one additional Junior Commandant of Cavalry, posthumous title Zhuangjie.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported Emperor Xuanzong wiped away tears and issued an edict, granted gold for the funeral, posthumous favors according to the provincial admiral precedent, the combined hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry with one additional Junior Commandant of Cavalry, and the posthumous title Zhuangjie.

sentences.zh: 賜兩子文武舉人，以簡襲世職，官至甘肅階州知州；

translations.literal: Both sons were granted the rank of civil and military licentiate for selection to inherit the hereditary rank; one rose to Prefect of Jiezhou in Gansu;
translations.idiomatic: Both sons were granted the rank of civil and military licentiate for selection to inherit the hereditary rank, and one rose to Prefect of Jiezhou in Gansu;

sentences.zh: 以敦官守備。

translations.literal: Dun held the post of Garrison Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Dun held the post of Garrison Commander.

sentences.zh: 雲飛兼能文，著有名將錄、制械製藥要言、水師緝捕管見、浙海險要圖說及詩文集。

translations.literal: Yunfei was also skilled in letters and authored Record of Famous Generals, Essentials of Making Weapons and Medicines, Views on Naval Pursuit and Capture, Illustrated Explanation of Strategic Points on the Zhejiang Coast, and collected poems and prose.
translations.idiomatic: Yunfei was also skilled in letters and authored Record of Famous Generals, Essentials of Making Weapons and Medicines, Views on Naval Pursuit and Capture, Illustrated Explanation of Strategic Points on the Zhejiang Coast, and collected poems and prose.

sentences.zh: 事母孝，母亦知大義，喪歸，一慟而止，曰：「吾有子矣！

translations.literal: He was filial to his mother; his mother also understood great principle; on returning for mourning he wept once and stopped, saying: "I have a son!"
translations.idiomatic: He was filial to his mother, who also understood great principle. On returning for mourning he wept once and stopped, saying, "I have a son!"

sentences.zh: =王錫朋=錫朋，字樵傭，順天寧河人。

translations.literal: Wang Xipeng, courtesy name Qiaoyong, a native of Ninghe in Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xipeng, with the courtesy name Qiaoyong, was a native of Ninghe in Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 以武舉授兵部差官，遷固原游擊。

translations.literal: As a military licentiate he was appointed an officer of the Ministry of War and transferred to Colonel of Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: As a military licentiate he was appointed an officer of the Ministry of War and transferred to Colonel of Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 從陝甘總督楊遇春徵回疆，大河拐、洋阿爾巴特、沙布都爾、渾河諸戰並有功，賜花翎，擢湖南臨武營參將。

translations.literal: He followed Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Yang Yuchun in campaigning in Xinjiang; at Daheguai, Yang A'erbate, Shabuduer, Hunhe, and other battles he had merit, was granted the peacock feather, and promoted to Colonel of Linwu Garrison in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Yang Yuchun in campaigning in Xinjiang. At Daheguai, Yang A'erbate, Shabuduer, Hunhe, and other battles he earned merit, was granted the peacock feather, and promoted to Colonel of Linwu Garrison in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 十二年，從剿江華瑤趙金龍，賜號銳勇巴圖魯，擢寶慶協副將。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he followed the suppression of Zhao Jinlong of the Jianghua Yao and was granted the title Ruiyong Batulu, promoted to Deputy Commander of Baoxing Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he followed the suppression of Zhao Jinlong of the Jianghua Yao and was granted the title Ruiyong Batulu, then promoted to Deputy Commander of the Baoxing Brigade.

sentences.zh: 又平廣東連州瑤，功最。

translations.literal: He also pacified the Yao of Lianzhou in Guangdong with the greatest merit.
translations.idiomatic: He also pacified the Yao of Lianzhou in Guangdong with the greatest merit.

sentences.zh: 擢汀州鎮總兵，以憂歸。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Commander of Tingzhou Garrison and returned home on account of mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Commander of Tingzhou Garrison and returned home on account of mourning.

sentences.zh: 十八年，起授壽春鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was recalled and appointed Commander of Shouchun Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was recalled and appointed Commander of Shouchun Garrison.

sentences.zh: 二十年，偕提督陳化成防吳淞，伊里布調援寧波。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he joined Admiral Chen Huacheng in defending Wusong; Yilibu transferred him to reinforce Ningbo.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he joined Admiral Chen Huacheng in defending Wusong. Yilibu transferred him to reinforce Ningbo.

sentences.zh: 尋偕葛雲飛等守定海。

translations.literal: Soon he joined Ge Yunfei and others in defending Dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he joined Ge Yunfei and others in defending Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 敵至，錫朋初守竹山門​​，為諸軍應援，數獲勝。

translations.literal: When the enemy arrived Xipeng first defended Zhushan Gate as reinforcement for the armies and won several victories.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy arrived Xipeng first defended Zhushan Gate as reinforcement for the armies and won several victories.

sentences.zh: 及敵乘霧登曉峰嶺，以無巨砲不能禦，率兵奮擊，並分援竹山，所部裨弁硃匯源、呂林環、劉桂五、夏敏忠、張魁甲先後陣歿，眾且盡，錫朋手刃數人，遂遇害。

translations.literal: When the enemy climbed Xiaofeng Ridge in fog they had no great cannon to resist; Xipeng led troops in fierce attack and also divided relief to Zhushan; his subordinate officers Zhu Huiyuan, Lu Linhuan, Liu Guiwu, Xia Minzhong, and Zhang Kuaijia died in battle one after another; his force was nearly exhausted; Xipeng personally killed several men and then met his death.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy climbed Xiaofeng Ridge in fog they had no great cannon to resist. Xipeng led troops in fierce attack and also divided relief to Zhushan. His subordinate officers Zhu Huiyuan, Lu Linhuan, Liu Guiwu, Xia Minzhong, and Zhang Kuaijia died in battle one after another, his force was nearly exhausted, Xipeng personally killed several men, and then met his death.

sentences.zh: 久之始得其屍，面如生，耳際有創。

translations.literal: Only after a long time was his body found; his face was as in life and there was a wound beside the ear.
translations.idiomatic: Only after a long time was his body found. His face was as in life and there was a wound beside the ear.

sentences.zh: 巡撫劉韻珂驗實，為改殮，卹典加等，予騎都尉兼一云騎尉世職，諡剛節。

translations.literal: Governor Liu Yunke verified the facts, had the encoffining changed, posthumous favors were granted one grade higher, the combined hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry with one additional Junior Commandant of Cavalry, posthumous title Gangjie.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Liu Yunke verified the facts and had the encoffining changed. Posthumous favors were granted one grade higher, with the combined hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry with one additional Junior Commandant of Cavalry and the posthumous title Gangjie.

sentences.zh: 子承泗、承瀚，並賜文舉人，承泗襲世職，官山西溫州知州；

translations.literal: His sons Chengsi and Chenghan were both granted the rank of licentiate; Chengsi inherited the hereditary rank and rose to Prefect of Wenzhou in Shanxi;
translations.idiomatic: His sons Chengsi and Chenghan were both granted the rank of licentiate. Chengsi inherited the hereditary rank and rose to Prefect of Wenzhou in Shanxi;

sentences.zh: 承瀚工部主事。

translations.literal: Chenghan served as a Principal in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghan served as a Principal in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: =鄭國鴻=國鴻，字雪堂，湖南鳳凰廳人。

translations.literal: Zheng Guohong, courtesy name Xuetang, a native of Fenghuang Subprefecture in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Guohong, with the courtesy name Xuetang, was a native of Fenghuang Subprefecture in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 父朝桂，貴州副將。

translations.literal: His father Chaogui was Deputy Commander of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Chaogui was Deputy Commander of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 伯父廷松，鎮筸千總，殉苗難，無子，以國鴻嗣，襲雲騎尉。

translations.literal: His uncle Tingsong was Company Commander of Zhenbian Garrison and died a martyr in the Miao troubles without a son; Guohong was adopted as heir and inherited the rank of Junior Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: His uncle Tingsong was Company Commander of Zhenbian Garrison and died a martyr in the Miao troubles without a son. Guohong was adopted as heir and inherited the rank of Junior Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 從傅鼐剿苗，授永綏屯守備，洊擢寶慶副將。

translations.literal: He followed Fu Nai in suppressing the Miao, was appointed Garrison Commander of Yongshui Colony, and was gradually promoted to Deputy Commander of Baoxing Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Fu Nai in suppressing the Miao, was appointed Garrison Commander of Yongshui Colony, and was gradually promoted to Deputy Commander of the Baoxing Brigade.

sentences.zh: 道光二十年，擢處州鎮總兵，調防鎮海，充翼長。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Daoguang he was promoted to Commander of Chuzhou Garrison and transferred to defend Zhenhai as wing commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of the Daoguang reign he was promoted to Commander of Chuzhou Garrison and transferred to defend Zhenhai as wing commander.

sentences.zh: 定海既還，移兵分守要隘。

translations.literal: After Dinghai was recovered he moved troops to divide defense of strategic passes.
translations.idiomatic: After Dinghai was recovered he moved troops to divide the defense of strategic passes.

sentences.zh: 敵艦初犯竹山門，國鴻發巨砲斷其桅，遂以竹山為分汛地。

translations.literal: When enemy ships first attacked Zhushan Gate Guohong fired great cannon and broke their mast; thereafter Zhushan became his separate garrison post.
translations.idiomatic: When enemy ships first attacked Zhushan Gate Guohong fired great cannon and broke their mast. Thereafter Zhushan became his separate garrison post.

sentences.zh: 戰連日，久雨，往來泥淖。

translations.literal: Battle continued for days; long rain made coming and going through mud.
translations.idiomatic: Battle continued for days amid long rain that made coming and going through mud difficult.

sentences.zh: 及敵分三路同時來撲，國鴻奮擊，槍砲皆熱不可用，短兵拒戰，而土寇導敵奪曉峰嶺，險要盡失，國鴻單騎衝陣，被數十創而殞，依總兵賜卹，予騎都尉世職，追諡忠節。

translations.literal: When the enemy divided into three routes and attacked at once Guohong fought fiercely; guns and cannon grew too hot to use and he resisted with short weapons; local bandits guided the enemy to seize Xiaofeng Ridge and all strategic points were lost; Guohong charged the formation alone on horseback, received several dozen wounds, and died; posthumous favors were granted according to the brigade general precedent, the hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry, posthumous title Zhongjie.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy divided into three routes and attacked at once Guohong fought fiercely. Guns and cannon grew too hot to use and he resisted with short weapons. Local bandits guided the enemy to seize Xiaofeng Ridge and all strategic points were lost. Guohong charged the formation alone on horseback, received several dozen wounds, and died. Posthumous favors were granted according to the brigade general precedent, with the hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry and the posthumous title Zhongjie.

sentences.zh: 子鼎聲已歿，賜其孫鍔、銛並為舉人，鍔襲騎都尉，七品小京官；

translations.literal: His son Dingsheng had already died; his grandsons E and Qian were both granted the rank of licentiate; E inherited Commandant of Cavalry and served as a seventh-rank secretary at court;
translations.idiomatic: His son Dingsheng had already died. His grandsons E and Qian were both granted the rank of licentiate. E inherited Commandant of Cavalry and served as a seventh-rank secretary at court;

sentences.zh: 銛襲雲騎尉。

translations.literal: Qian inherited Junior Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Qian inherited the rank of Junior Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 出繼之子鼎臣，批驗大使，從軍中，揚威將軍奕經令募水勇攻敵海山港，賜花翎、四品頂戴。

translations.literal: His adopted son Dingchen was an inspection envoy who followed the army; General Yijing ordered him to recruit naval braves to attack the enemy at Haishan Harbor and granted the peacock feather and fourth-rank cap button.
translations.idiomatic: His adopted son Dingchen was an inspection envoy who followed the army. General Yijing ordered him to recruit naval braves to attack the enemy at Haishan Harbor and granted him the peacock feather and fourth-rank cap button.

sentences.zh: 三鎮死事最烈，併入昭忠祠。

translations.literal: The three commanders' deaths were most fierce and all were enshrined together at the Shrine of Loyalty and Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: The three commanders' deaths were most fierce, and all were enshrined together at the Shrine of Loyalty and Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 定海收復，建立專祠，合祀雲飛、錫朋，並許原籍各建專祠。

translations.literal: When Dinghai was recovered a special shrine was built enshrining Yunfei and Xipeng together, and they were also permitted to build special shrines in their native places.
translations.idiomatic: When Dinghai was recovered a dedicated shrine was built enshrining Yunfei and Xipeng together, and they were also permitted to build dedicated shrines in their native places.

sentences.zh: 當定海之初陷也，總兵張朝發戰於港口，兵敗，身受砲傷，知縣姚懷祥、典史全福皆死之。

translations.literal: When Dinghai first fell Brigade General Zhang Chaofa fought at the harbor, the army was defeated, he himself was wounded by cannon fire, Prefect Yao Huaixiang and Clerk Quan Fu all died.
translations.idiomatic: When Dinghai first fell Brigade General Zhang Chaofa fought at the harbor. The army was defeated, he himself was wounded by cannon fire, and Prefect Yao Huaixiang and Clerk Quan Fu all died.

sentences.zh: 時咎朝發不專守陸路，巡撫烏爾恭額疏劾逮治。

translations.literal: At the time Chaofa was blamed for not concentrating on defending the land route; Governor Wu Ergong'e memorialized impeachment and he was arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Chaofa was blamed for not concentrating on defending the land route. Governor Wu Ergong'e memorialized impeachment and he was arrested for trial.

sentences.zh: 朝發已以傷殞，卹典不及焉。

translations.literal: Chaofa had already died of his wounds and posthumous favors did not reach him.
translations.idiomatic: Chaofa had already died of his wounds and posthumous favors did not reach him.

sentences.zh: 浙中戰事以定海為最力。

translations.literal: Among battles in Zhejiang the fighting at Dinghai was fiercest.
translations.idiomatic: Among battles in Zhejiang the fighting at Dinghai was fiercest.

sentences.zh: 後揚威將軍奕經督師，將帥多闒茸，戰事如兒戲，惟金華協副將硃貴稱忠勇。

translations.literal: Later when General Yijing commanded the army most commanders were incompetent and warfare was like child's play; only Deputy Commander Zhu Gui of the Jinhua Brigade was called loyal and brave.
translations.idiomatic: Later when General Yijing commanded the army most commanders were incompetent and warfare was like child's play. Only Deputy Commander Zhu Gui of the Jinhua Brigade was called loyal and brave.

sentences.zh: =硃貴=貴，字黻堂，甘肅河州人。

translations.literal: Zhu Gui, courtesy name Futang, a native of Hezhou in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Gui, with the courtesy name Futang, was a native of Hezhou in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 以武生入伍，從征川、陝教匪，剿藍號賊於盧家灣。

translations.literal: As a military student he entered the ranks and campaigned in Sichuan and Shaanxi against sect rebels, suppressing the Blue Banner bandits at Lujiawan.
translations.idiomatic: As a military student he entered the ranks and campaigned in Sichuan and Shaanxi against sect rebels, suppressing the Blue Banner bandits at Lujiawan.

sentences.zh: 賊渠冉學勝伏密箐中，以長矛刺傷主將，貴奪其矛而擒之，勇冠軍中。

translations.literal: Bandit chieftain Ran Xuesheng lay hidden in a dense ravine and stabbed the commanding general with a long spear; Gui seized the spear and captured him, his valor foremost in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Bandit chieftain Ran Xuesheng lay hidden in a dense ravine and stabbed the commanding general with a long spear. Gui seized the spear and captured him, his valor foremost in the army.

sentences.zh: 滑縣、三才峽諸役，皆在事有功，累擢涼州守備。

translations.literal: At Huaxian, Sancai Gorge, and other campaigns he had merit and was repeatedly promoted to Garrison Commander of Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At Huaxian, Sancai Gorge, and other campaigns he had merit and was repeatedly promoted to Garrison Commander of Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 道光初，從楊遇春戰回疆，擢游擊，歷陝西西安參將、署察漢托洛亥副將。

translations.literal: In the early Daoguang period he followed Yang Yuchun in fighting Xinjiang, was promoted to Colonel, and served successively as Colonel of Xi'an in Shaanxi and acting Deputy Commander of Chahantuoluohei.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Daoguang period he followed Yang Yuchun in fighting Xinjiang, was promoted to Colonel, and served successively as Colonel of Xi'an in Shaanxi and acting Deputy Commander of Chahantuoluohei.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，擢浙江金華協副將。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was promoted to Deputy Commander of the Jinhua Brigade in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was promoted to Deputy Commander of the Jinhua Brigade in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 揚威將軍奕經督師，貴率陝甘兵九百以從。

translations.literal: When General Yijing commanded the army Gui led nine hundred Shaanxi-Gansu troops to follow.
translations.idiomatic: When General Yijing commanded the army Gui led nine hundred Shaanxi-Gansu troops to follow.

sentences.zh: 時兵多新募，惟貴所部最號勁旅。

translations.literal: At that time most troops were newly recruited; only Gui's command was called the strongest force.
translations.idiomatic: At that time most troops were newly recruited. Only Gui's command was called the strongest force.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春，奕經規复寧波、鎮海，令貴當鎮海一路，行未至，寧波已失利，止勿進，調赴長谿嶺大營，遂屯慈谿城西大寶山。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-second year Yijing planned to recover Ningbo and Zhenhai and ordered Gui to take the Zhenhai route; he had not yet arrived when Ningbo was already lost; he was ordered to halt advance and was transferred to the great camp at Changxi Ridge, then garrisoned Dabao Hill west of Cixi city.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-second year Yijing planned to recover Ningbo and Zhenhai and ordered Gui to take the Zhenhai route. He had not yet arrived when Ningbo was already lost. He was ordered to halt his advance and was transferred to the great camp at Changxi Ridge, then garrisoned Dabao Hill west of Cixi city.

sentences.zh: 敵乘勝以二千人自大西壩登岸，貴率所部迎擊，斃敵四百餘人。

translations.literal: The enemy, following up victory, landed two thousand men from Daxiba; Gui led his command to meet the attack and killed more than four hundred enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy, following up victory, landed two thousand men from Daxiba. Gui led his command to meet the attack and killed more than four hundred enemy.

sentences.zh: 再卻再進，自辰至申，軍中不得食，猶酣戰。

translations.literal: They were driven back and advanced again; from chen to shen hour the army had not eaten yet still fought fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: They were driven back and advanced again. From mid-morning until late afternoon the army had not eaten yet still fought fiercely.

sentences.zh: 鄉勇忽亂隊，敵由山後鈔襲，增者幾倍。

translations.literal: Suddenly the village braves fell into disorder; the enemy outflanked from behind the hill and their numbers increased several fold.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly the village braves fell into disorder. The enemy outflanked from behind the hill and their numbers increased several fold.

sentences.zh: 又三艦自丈亭江直逼山下，長谿大營驚潰。

translations.literal: Three more ships from Zhangting River pressed straight below the hill and the great camp at Changxi broke in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Three more ships from Zhangting River pressed straight below the hill and the great camp at Changxi broke in alarm.

sentences.zh: 貴腹背被攻，怒馬斫陣，中槍馬倒，躍起奪敵矛奮鬥，傷要害，乃踣。

translations.literal: Gui was attacked front and rear; on an angry horse he cut through the formation, was struck by gunfire and his horse fell; he leaped up, seized an enemy spear, and fought fiercely until wounded in a vital place and collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Gui was attacked front and rear. On an angry horse he cut through the formation, was struck by gunfire and his horse fell. He leaped up, seized an enemy spear, and fought fiercely until wounded in a vital place and collapsed.

sentences.zh: 子武生昭南，以身障父，同時陣亡。

translations.literal: His son Zhaonan, a military student, shielded his father with his body and died in battle together.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhaonan, a military student, shielded his father with his body and died in battle together.

sentences.zh: 部下游擊黃泰，守備徐宦、陳芝蘭，浙江候補知縣顏履敬等，兵卒三百餘人，同死。

translations.literal: Colonel Huang Tai, Garrison Commanders Xu Huan and Chen Zhilan, Acting Prefect Yan Lüjing of Zhejiang, and more than three hundred soldiers and officers died together.
translations.idiomatic: Colonel Huang Tai, Garrison Commanders Xu Huan and Chen Zhilan, Acting Prefect Yan Lüjing of Zhejiang, and more than three hundred soldiers and officers died together.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其忠勇，依總兵例賜卹，予騎都尉世職，子廷瑞襲。

translations.literal: An edict praised his loyal valor, posthumous favors were granted according to the brigade general precedent, the hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry, and son Tingrui inherited.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised his loyal valor. Posthumous favors were granted according to the brigade general precedent, with the hereditary rank of Commandant of Cavalry, and son Tingrui inherited the rank.

sentences.zh: 昭南予雲騎尉世職，子輶甫四歲，命及歲襲職。

translations.literal: Zhaonan was granted the hereditary rank of Junior Commandant of Cavalry; his son Youfu was only four years old and ordered to inherit when he came of age.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaonan was granted the hereditary rank of Junior Commandant of Cavalry. His son Youfu was only four years old and was ordered to inherit when he came of age.

sentences.zh: 阿木穰，世襲土司，大金河千總，加副將銜、巴圖魯勇號。

translations.literal: Amuzang, hereditary native chieftain, Company Commander of the Great Golden River, granted the rank of deputy commander and the brave title Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: Amuzang, a hereditary native chieftain and Company Commander of the Great Golden River, was granted the rank of deputy commander and the brave title Batulu.

sentences.zh: 哈克里，瓦寺土守備，率金川屯練赴軍，皆趫捷奮勇，戰輒爭先。

translations.literal: Hakeli, native garrison commander of Wasi, led Jinchuan colony troops to the army; both were agile and valiant and in battle always strove to be first.
translations.idiomatic: Hakeli, native garrison commander of Wasi, led Jinchuan colony troops to the army. Both were agile and valiant and in battle always strove to be first.

sentences.zh: 冠虎形，奕經佔有虎頭之兆，令赴前敵，從提督段永福攻寧波。

translations.literal: They had tiger-shaped caps; Yijing's divination possessed the omen of a tiger's head and he ordered them to the front, following Admiral Duan Yongfu in attacking Ningbo.
translations.idiomatic: They wore tiger-shaped caps. Yijing's divination possessed the omen of a tiger's head and he ordered them to the front to follow Admiral Duan Yongfu in attacking Ningbo.

sentences.zh: 敵已為備，至則城門不閉。

translations.literal: The enemy was already prepared; when they arrived the city gate was not closed.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy was already prepared. When they arrived the city gate was not closed.

sentences.zh: 阿木穰率土司兵先入，中地雷同歿。

translations.literal: Amuzang led native troops in first; he was killed by a land mine.
translations.idiomatic: Amuzang led native troops in first and was killed by a land mine.

sentences.zh: 哈克里攻奪招寶山，猱升而上，搶入威遠城。

translations.literal: Hakeli attacked and seized Zhaobao Hill, climbing like monkeys and rushing into Weiyuan City.
translations.idiomatic: Hakeli attacked and seized Zhaobao Hill, climbing like monkeys and rushing into Weiyuan City.

sentences.zh: 敵艦自金雞山翦江至，用砲仰擊，遂不支而退，後亦殉難，浙人哀之。

translations.literal: Enemy ships came from Jinjishan cutting across the river and fired upward with cannon; they could not hold and withdrew, and later Hakeli also died a martyr; the people of Zhejiang mourned them.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy ships came from Jinjishan cutting across the river and fired upward with cannon. They could not hold and withdrew, and later Hakeli also died a martyr. The people of Zhejiang mourned them.

sentences.zh: 自硃貴大寶山之戰，敵受創甚鉅，遂戒深入，慈谿縣城獲完。

translations.literal: From Zhu Gui's battle at Dabao Hill the enemy suffered very heavy losses and then forbade deep advance; Cixi county seat was preserved intact.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhu Gui's battle at Dabao Hill the enemy suffered very heavy losses and then forbade deep advance. Cixi county seat was preserved intact.

sentences.zh: 士民思其功，為建祠報賽，阿木穰、哈克里亦附祀焉。

translations.literal: The gentry and people remembered his merit and built a shrine to repay his service; Amuzang and Hakeli were also enshrined there.
translations.idiomatic: The gentry and people remembered his merit and built a shrine to repay his service. Amuzang and Hakeli were also enshrined there.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：海疆戰事起，既絀於兵械，又昧於敵情，又牽掣於和戰之無定，畏葸者敗，忠勇者亦敗。

translations.literal: Commentary says: When coastal warfare arose, China was inferior in arms, ignorant of the enemy, and moreover constrained by uncertainty between war and peace; the timid were defeated, and the loyal and brave were also defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary says: When coastal warfare arose, China was inferior in arms, ignorant of the enemy, and moreover constrained by uncertainty between war and peace. The timid were defeated, and the loyal and brave were also defeated.

sentences.zh: 專閫之臣，忘身殉國，義不返踵，亦各求其心之所安耳。

translations.literal: Commanders-in-chief forgot themselves and died for the state, righteousness allowing no turning back; each sought only what his heart could rest in.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders-in-chief forgot themselves and died for the state, righteousness allowing no turning back. Each sought only what his heart could rest in.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼，烈已！

translations.literal: Alas, how fierce their martyrdom!
translations.idiomatic: Alas, how fierce their martyrdom!

sentences.zh: 偏裨授命者，附著於篇。

translations.literal: Subordinate officers who gave their lives are recorded in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate officers who gave their lives are recorded in this chapter.
